correctness.rationale: For n=3k+1≥7 and h=k+1, every minimum maximal matching has h selected cycle edges with exactly two gaps of size 2 among gaps otherwise 3. The published bracelet exchange coordinate maps under multiplication by −k mod n to two unlabeled particles at separation between h and n−h, each legal exchange moving one point ±1. Upper bound floor(n/2) follows by exhaustive circular-order cases: same point, four alternating points, or grouped points, with inward interleaving respecting separation. For arbitrary start {0,d}, a target {u,d+w} with u+w=floor(n/2) gives unrestricted assignment travel lower bound floor(n/2); reconfiguration cannot beat individual circular travel, so all vertices attain it. New independent BFS from direct separated-particle construction for k=2..10 confirmed each distance and complete connectivity; finite BFS is corroboration, not infinite proof.
residual_risks: Applies only C_{3k+1}, k≥2, and minimum maximal matchings, not arbitrary matching exchanges.
